eval: (() => { const w = __game.walker; const out = []; for (const yaw of [0, Math.PI / 4, Math.PI / 2, 3 * Math.PI / 4, Math.PI, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 4, -3 * Math.PI / 4]) for (const [key, dir] of [['KeyW', 'f'], ['KeyS', 'b'], ['KeyD', 'r'], ['KeyA', 'l']]) { w.moveTo(new V3(0, -2, 12.5), yaw); const p0 = w.pos.clone(); w.frame({ keys: new Set([key]), dx: 0, dy: 0 }, 0.1); const d = w.pos.clone().sub(p0).normalize(); const f = w.forward(); f.y = 0; f.normalize(); const r = new V3(-f.z, 0, f.x); const want = { f, b: f.clone().negate(), r, l: r.clone().negate() }[dir]; out.push(d.dot(want)); } w.moveTo(__game.interior.spawn.clone(), 0); return JSON.stringify({ worst: Math.round(Math.min(...out) * 1000) / 1000, n: out.length }); })()
